parameters: Hundreds of children have been brought here...

The Zanatus cult way of life is perverse, so they must indoctrinate children, the only way to create a like-minded generation.\! These people...\| if left unchecked, they'll transform the whole world into mindless drones to serve their purposes.\! And they have time on their side.\! If we win this war, there will be no mercy for them...\| I'll make sure they and their ideas are extinct forever.
The Sisterhood of Mercy...\| fighting for the enemy?!
...What?!\! Probably being blackmailed... as if I needed more reason to wipe these guys out!
\n[8], please do not take the lives of my Sisters...\| If we defeat the cultists...
I hear you.\! Let's hope the bad guys haven't made that impossible.
Sister Diana...\| My shame is boundless.\! Please forgive me...
You kept yourself alive.\! For that you need not be forgiven.\! Come with me, Edelia... may we never part again.
...I will, Sister!\! How I have longed to fight by your side!

display_name: Chapter 20-C: No Mercy for the Merciful
note: kill as few priestesses as possible before you kill cultist boss
